briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 training run hits 10^27 FLOPs amid escalating US-China chip tensions

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with multiple 10^26+ model runs underway. Compute constraints and export controls tighten the race between US and Chinese players. Regulatory scrutiny rises as safety incidents multiply.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI's Orion-2 enters final training phase with 2.4T parameters. Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus while Google DeepMind deploys Gemini 3. Meta open-sources Llama 4 405B. xAI Colossus cluster reaches 300k H100s.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. New multi-agent exploits reported at scale. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for automotive and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC begins 2nm AI chip production for NVIDIA Blackwell. Microsoft and Oracle announce joint 5GW data center buildout in Texas. Saudi Arabia commits $40B to sovereign AI infrastructure.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a state-backed Chinese effort before 2028?
